concurrency: Single-threaded pure compilation; one bounded compile per call over immutable normalized resources; no shared mutable state, no worker, thread, coroutine, timer, or background work. Compiler-emitted structures are fresh and owned by the caller; the volatile run envelope is the only per-call value and never enters the plan body.
inputs: normalized Scenario steps and step-intent payloads
outputs: plan.lifecycleIntent[] in the frozen (timeDomainId, atTicks, phaseRank, stepId) order
purpose: Compile declared lifecycle intent into an explicitly ordered, dependency-ordered intent list in the resolved plan without starting, stopping, probing or otherwise influencing any process, service or device.
state: Stateless ordered intent list; no lifecycle handle, permit or provider is constructed.

static_checks.expected: ast scan shows no import of xverse_xdl.lifecycle or process-starting module
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse, jsonschema meta-schema validation, additive diff scope check)

title: XDL1-SR-003-U unit specification - Declared lifecycle intent without lifecycle execution

unit_cases.expected: lifecycleIntent ordered by (timeDomainId, atTicks, phaseRank, stepId) with the frozen phase rank
unit_cases.precondition: steps in one domain and equal ticks with phases prepare/start/observe/stop/cleanup declared out of order
